The short version
  • We collect only what we need to answer you, provide our services and get paid.
  • Card payments are handled by Stripe. We never see or store your full card number.
  • This website uses no advertising or analytics cookies, and we don't track you across other sites.
  • We do not sell or share your personal information for advertising.
  • You can access, correct or delete your information, or opt out, at any time on our Privacy Choices page.

Who we are

This policy explains how CORPCIO Global LLC, trading as Corpcio (“we”, “us”, “our”), handles personal information when you visit corpcio.com, contact us, or use our services. We are the “controller” responsible for that information.

Contact for all privacy matters: [Contact email], 8 The Green, Suite 4000, Dover, DE 19901, USA.

What we collect

Information you give us

  • Contact details: name, email address, phone number, company name and job title.
  • Business information: details about your business, products, markets and plans that you share so we can advise you.
  • Communications: the messages you send us and our records of calls and meetings.
  • Billing details: billing name and address, and tax or VAT number where relevant.

Payment information

When you pay us, you enter your card details on a payment page hosted by Stripe. Stripe processes the payment and gives us limited information about it: your name, email, billing country, card brand, the last four digits and expiry date of your card, and the amount, date and status of the payment. We never receive or store your full card number or security code. Stripe uses payment information under its own privacy policy, including to prevent fraud.

Information collected automatically

When you visit the Website, our hosting provider automatically records standard technical information in server logs: your IP address, browser and device type, the pages you request, the referring page, and the date and time. This is used only to run and secure the Website.

Information from others

We may receive information about you from Stripe (such as payment status), from someone who refers you to us, or from public sources such as company registries when we check who we are working with.

Cookies and tracking

This Website does not use advertising, analytics or social-media cookies, and does not use tracking pixels or similar technologies. Fonts and images are served from our own website, so loading a page does not send your information to third-party font or tracking services. Because we set no non-essential cookies, we don't show a cookie banner. If that ever changes, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where the law requires it.

Stripe's payment pages set their own cookies, which are necessary for secure payment and fraud prevention. They are described in Stripe's cookie policy.

How we use it

We use personal information only for the purposes below. Where the GDPR or UK GDPR applies, the legal basis for each is shown.

PurposeLegal basis
Answering your enquiries and preparing quotesSteps you ask for before entering a contract; our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries
Providing our services and managing your EngagementPerformance of our contract with you
Invoicing, taking payments and issuing refundsPerformance of our contract; legal obligation
Preventing fraud and keeping the Website secureOur legitimate interests in protecting our business and our clients
Keeping accounting and tax recordsLegal obligation
Checking we can lawfully work with you (for example, sanctions screening)Legal obligation; our legitimate interests
Sending service messages about your EngagementPerformance of our contract
Sending occasional news about our servicesYour consent, or our legitimate interests for existing clients where the law allows. You can opt out at any time.
Establishing, exercising or defending legal claimsOur legitimate interests

We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing that have legal or similarly significant effects. Stripe may use automated tools to detect fraudulent payments.

Who we share it with

We share personal information only with:

  • Stripe, to process payments and refunds and prevent fraud;
  • Service providers who host our Website, provide our email and document storage, or help with accounting. They act on our instructions under contracts that require them to protect your information;
  • Professional advisers such as accountants, auditors, lawyers and insurers, under duties of confidentiality;
  • Third parties you ask us to involve in your Engagement, and only on your instruction;
  • Authorities, where the law requires it or to protect our rights or the safety of others;
  • A buyer or successor, if our business is reorganised, sold or merged. They will be bound by this policy.

We don't sell your data

We do not sell personal information, and we do not “share” it for cross-context behavioural advertising (as those terms are used in US state privacy laws). We have not done so in the past 12 months. We do not knowingly sell or share the personal information of anyone under 16.

International transfers

Our service providers, including Stripe, may process information in countries other than yours, including the United States. Where we transfer personal information out of the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or another country with transfer rules, we rely on an adequacy decision or on appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (and the UK Addendum). You can ask us for details.

How long we keep it

  • Enquiries that don't lead to an Engagement: up to 24 months after our last contact, then deleted.
  • Client, contract and payment records: for as long as the Engagement lasts, and then for the period required by tax and accounting law (usually between 6 and 10 years, depending on the country).
  • Server logs: for a short period, normally no more than 90 days, unless we need them to investigate a security incident.
  • Marketing preferences: if you opt out, we keep a record of your opt-out so we don't contact you again.

Security

The Website is served only over encrypted HTTPS connections. Access to client information is restricted to people who need it, and we use reputable providers with strong security. Card payments are handled by Stripe, which is certified to PCI DSS Level 1, the highest level of payment-industry security. No system is perfectly secure, but if a breach affects your information, we will notify you and the relevant authorities where the law requires it.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:

  • access the personal information we hold about you and get a copy;
  • correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete;
  • delete your information;
  • restrict or object to how we use it, including for direct marketing (you can always object to marketing);
  • port information you gave us to another organisation in a machine-readable format;
  • withdraw consent where we rely on it, without affecting what we did before;
  • complain to a data protection authority.

To use these rights, go to our Privacy Choices page or email [Contact email]. We will respond within one month, or within the shorter or longer period your local law sets. We may need to verify your identity first, and there is normally no charge. Some information we must keep by law, for example invoices, even if you ask us to delete it. If so, we will tell you.

US state privacy rights

If you live in California or another US state with a comprehensive privacy law, you have the right to know what personal information we collect, use and disclose; to access, correct and delete it; to opt out of its sale, sharing or use for targeted advertising (we do none of these); and not to be discriminated against for using your rights.

In the past 12 months we have collected these categories of personal information, from the sources and for the purposes described above: identifiers (such as name, email, IP address); commercial information (records of services purchased); internet activity (server logs of Website visits); and professional information (company and job title). We have disclosed them for business purposes only to the categories of recipients listed in Who we share it with.

You can make a request yourself or through an authorised agent, on our Privacy Choices page or by email. We honour Global Privacy Control browser signals as a request to opt out. If we deny your request, you may appeal by replying to our decision, and we will respond to the appeal within the time your state's law requires.

Marketing and opting out

We only send marketing emails if you have agreed to receive them, or where the law allows us to contact existing clients about similar services. Every marketing email includes an unsubscribe link. You can also opt out at any time on our Privacy Choices page or by emailing us. Even if you opt out, we will still send you messages you need about an Engagement or a payment.

Children

Our services are for businesses and adults. They are not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has given us personal information, please contact us and we will delete it.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page with its effective date. If we make significant changes, we will tell clients by email before they take effect.
